name: Ritual Vessel
description: Stores the monsters slain for the first time from a completed Ritual Altar for future use
directions: Right-click this item then left-click a Ritual Altar to store the monsters from the completed Ritual in this item. Cannot be used on a Ritual in a map opened with a Blood-Filled Vessel.
consoleDirections: Use this item on a Ritual Altar to store the monsters from the completed Ritual in the item. Cannot be used on a Ritual in a map opened with a Blood-Filled Vessel.
